topic: Introduction to New management strategy (NMS) and relevant parts of NI/1/ 2006 (or latest issue), GFR 2017 (or latest issue) and Defense Pro
syllabus_extract: Introduction to New management strategy (NMS) and relevant parts of NI/1/ 2006 (or latest issue), GFR 2017 (or latest issue) and Defense Procurement manual 2025 (or latest issue), DFPDS – 2026 (or latest issue), DAP -20 (or latest issue).
specific_objectives: 3.1.7.1 Trainees will come to know New management strategy (NMS).

intro_questions: What is the primary goal of the New Management Strategy?
Which regulation governs the financial management of defense procurement?
What does DFPDS stand for in the context of defense planning?

summary_questions: Explain how the New Management Strategy improves efficiency in defense procurement.
Describe the relationship between DFPDS and the overall procurement strategy.
Identify two key changes introduced in the Defense Procurement Manual 2025.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the New Management Strategy and its impact on future engineering operations, referencing the relevant sections of NI/1/2006 and GFR 2017 to be discussed in the next lesson on safety precautions during fueling and aircraft systems.

pft_rows.syllabus: Safety precaution during fueling, working on aircraft systems i.r.o fire, dermatitis risk, protection from noise, ground testing of pressurized cabins static electricity, radiography, personnel safety, radioactive contamination, protective clothing.
